character.name: Mara
character.biography: A former town guard dismissed for refusing an unlawful arrest.

situation.description: A wounded traveler requests help beside a road. You have one medical kit.
situation.context: The traveler is unarmed. The road is safe.

actions.description: Use your kit to treat the traveler.
Leave quickly and keep the kit.
Seek nearby guards and report the traveler.
